name: export-conformance
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun lean-kernel/conformance.ts --lemma-cuts > lean-kernel/LemmaConformance.lean; cd lean-kernel; TC=~/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0; export LEAN_PATH="$PWD:$TC/lib/lean"; "$TC/bin/lean" -o Count.olean Count.lean; "$TC/bin/lean" -o CountMachine.olean CountMachine.lean; "$TC/bin/lean" LemmaConformance.lean
